# Official chain assets

Files are unchanged originals, displayed with object-fit: contain and no recoloring.

- solana.svg: https://solana.com/src/img/branding/solanaLogoMark.svg — linked by https://solana.com/branding
- base.svg: Base_square_blue.svg in https://brand.base.org/base-brand.zip — linked by https://brand.base.org/core-identifiers
- ethereum.svg: https://ethereum.org/images/assets/svgs/eth-diamond-purple.svg — linked by https://ethereum.org/assets/
- bnb.svg: https://www.bnbchain.org/images/brand-guidelines/svg/BNB%20Chain_Symbol_Yellow.svg — linked by https://www.bnbchain.org/en/brand-guidelines

Robinhood Chain: official source https://cdn.robinhood.com/robinhood_chain/brand_assets/robinhood-chain-brand-assets-v1.zip linked by https://docs.robinhood.com/chain/brand-guidelines/. Download failed with TLS connection resets on this host. The filter displays text without a substitute logo pending this asset.
